headline: GOLD SLIDES TO $4,520, SILVER DIPS BELOW $75 AS IRAN PEACE DEAL HOPES COLLAPSE
snippet: Gold fell to $4,520/oz and silver dipped to $75.35 on May 22 as Iran's Supreme Leader issued a directive keeping uranium on Iranian soil, dashing peace deal prospects. Oil prices surged toward four-year highs, raising central bank tightening fears and creating a counterintuitive headwind for precious metals.

headline: COPPER HITS $6.28/LB: AI DATA CENTER ELECTRIFICATION MEETS IRAN OIL SHOCK
snippet: Copper futures climbed to $6.28/lb Thursday, up 2% on the session, driven by AI data center electrification demand that has dominated the commodity's narrative since early May. Chile's state copper commission Cochilco raised its 2026 price forecast to $5.55/lb citing sustained supply tightness and firm global demand.

headline: TRUMP FAST-TRACKS SEABED MINING: NINE COMPANIES BID FOR OCEAN FLOOR MINERALS
snippet: At least nine companies are negotiating with the US government for seabed mineral access following Trump's executive order fast-tracking offshore mining permits, with sections of seafloor from American Samoa to Alaska set to be auctioned this summer and through the fall. Targets include polymetallic nodules rich in nickel, cobalt, manganese and copper.

headline: FIRST MINING TURNS DRILLS AT DUPARQUET GOLD IN QUEBEC WITH INDIGENOUS DRILL PARTNER
snippet: First Mining Gold Corp launched its 2026 drill campaign at the Duparquet gold project in Quebec's Abitibi region on May 21, deploying two rigs for 12,000 metres in partnership with Indigenous-led Forage Anicinape. The program targets resource expansion at the Miroir zone, where 2025 drilling returned 3.74 g/t Au over 15.5m.

headline: URANIUM FIRMS TO $84.70/LB AS KAZATOMPROM CRUNCH DEEPENS; CME FUTURES LAUNCH NEARS
snippet: Uranium spot ticked up to $84.70/lb on May 21, 20% above year-ago levels, as Kazatomprom's worsening production outlook tightens the structural supply deficit. Market participants are watching for CME Group's imminent launch of a physically-settled uranium futures contract, seen as a potential liquidity catalyst for the sector.

headline: BMC MINERALS: KRAKATOA ZONE HITS 25m AT 9.7% ZINC IN YUKON; FEASIBILITY NPV AT $835M
snippet: BMC Minerals hit 25.1 metres at 9.7% zinc, 180 g/t Ag, 1 g/t Au and 0.3% copper in the new Krakatoa zone at its Kudz Ze Kayah project in Yukon, part of a 20,000m expansion drill campaign running through September. A 2023 feasibility study pegs the project's pre-tax NPV at $835M with a 42% IRR.

headline: COLLECTIVE MINING HITS 71m AT 1.95 G/T AUEQ — NEW OXIDE ZONE SURFACES IN COLOMBIA
snippet: Collective Mining announced on May 20 the discovery of a 700-metre-strike oxide gold-silver zone at Northern Apollo in Colombia, returning 71.20m at 1.95 g/t AuEq (0.75 g/t Au, 87 g/t Ag) from surface. If metallurgical test work confirms heap-leach viability, the oxide cap could become a standalone near-term production target above the primary sulphide resource.

headline: SILVER'S SIXTH CONSECUTIVE DEFICIT CONFIRMED; COMEX STOCKS HALVED SINCE OCTOBER 2025
snippet: The Silver Institute projects a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit of approximately 46 million ounces for 2026, as industrial demand from solar, EVs and electronics outpaces flat mine supply. COMEX registered silver inventories have collapsed from 531 million oz in October 2025 to just 315 million oz — a 41% drawdown in seven months.

headline: GOLD SWOT: CHINA'S 790-TONNE SILVER IMPORT BINGE SIGNALS A STRUCTURAL DEMAND SHIFT
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly SWOT analysis highlights China importing over 790 tonnes of silver in early 2026, driven by record solar panel manufacturing. With visible silver inventory declining simultaneously across Shanghai, COMEX and the LBMA, analysts see a structural demand shift that few retail investors have priced in.

headline: GR SILVER HITS BEST-EVER HOLE: 45.1m AT 1,623 G/T Ag INCL 8.25m AT 8,579 G/T IN MEXICO
snippet: GR Silver Mining's hole SMS26-04 in the SE Area of San Marcial returned 45.1 metres at 1,623 g/t Ag, including 8.25m at 8,579 g/t Ag — the company's highest-grade intercept ever drilled. Two rigs are active at the Plomosas Project in Sinaloa, Mexico as part of a planned 20,000-metre step-out campaign.

headline: TROILUS EXPANDS WEST RIM: 2.92 G/T AUEQ OVER 19m OUTSIDE RESOURCE PIT IN QUEBEC
snippet: Troilus Mining reported that drillhole WR-26-016 in the West Rim Zone returned 19 metres at 2.92 g/t AuEQ, located outside the current resource and within 200 metres of the North Reserve Pit. Analysts are watching Troilus closely as a potential M&A target — the zone remains open along strike to the north with assays still pending.

headline: JUGGERNAUT MOBILIZES 10,000m AT BIG ONE — DISTRICT-SCALE GOLD-SILVER-COPPER IN B.C.
snippet: Juggernaut Exploration (TSX-V: JUGR) has mobilized for its inaugural 10,000-metre drill program at the Big One property in B.C.'s Golden Triangle, a district-scale gold-silver-copper system where surface samples assay up to 263.70 g/t AuEq across shear-hosted veins exposed for over 1 km with 1 km of vertical relief.
